ItemId.description: The runtime state id, a generated unique id. A state with this id, or of the same enrollment and package, is updated.

UserName.description: The user name of the learner. A row whose user is not on the site is reported and skipped.

CourseId.description: The content item id of the course.

PackageItemId.description: The content item id of the learning package.

PackageTitle.description: The title of the package at the last launch.

PackageFileId.description: The package file of the last launch, in the protected store of the site it came from.

Standard.description: The standard of the package: SCORM 1.2, SCORM 2004 3rd Edition or SCORM 2004 4th Edition. Without one the state is SCORM 1.2.

Cmi.description: The SCORM 1.2 data: LessonStatus, ScoreRaw, ScoreMin, ScoreMax, TotalTime, LessonLocation, SuspendData, Exit, Entry, Comments, the student preferences, Objectives and Interactions.

Cmi2004.description: The SCORM 2004 data: Edition, CompletionStatus, SuccessStatus, ProgressMeasure, ScoreScaled, ScoreRaw, ScoreMin, ScoreMax, TotalTime, Location, SuspendData, Exit, Entry, NavRequest, the learner preferences, Objectives, Interactions and CommentsFromLearner.

Attempts.description: How many SCORM 2004 attempts the learner started.

Sessions.description: How many times the learner launched the package.

FirstLaunchedUtc.description: When the package was first launched, in UTC.

LastLaunchedUtc.description: When the package was last launched, in UTC.

LastCommitUtc.description: When the content last committed its data, in UTC.

LastFinishedUtc.description: When a session last finished, in UTC.

States.description: The runtime states to create, or update.
